image.title: Image generator
image.intro: Describe the image, dictate in your speech language, then review and edit the final English prompt before generation. The enhancer targets a short CLIP-friendly prompt; the current native bridge does not expose an exact CLIP token counter.
image.promptPlaceholder: Describe the image you want to create…
image.enhancing: Loading the selected text model and preparing an English prompt…
image.previewReady: Preview ready. Edit the prompt before generating.
image.enhancementUnavailable: Enhancement unavailable: {{error}}. Your original prompt is unchanged.
image.unsupported: Sampler, denoising strength, inpainting and LoRA are not exposed by the current OGAM image-generation request/native bridge, so they are intentionally not shown as working controls.
image.invalidSteps: Choose a whole number from 4 to {{max}}.
image.invalidCfg: Guidance scale must be greater than 0 and no more than 30.
image.invalidSeed: Use a non-negative whole number, or leave it blank for a random seed.
image.whisperRequiredBody: Download and select a Whisper model in Models → Voice before using dictation.
image.whisperMemoryBlocked: There is not enough free memory to load Whisper alongside the current model. Eject the text or image model and try again.
models.scanDescription: Choose a folder through Android’s system picker. The scanner reads file names and sizes without copying multi-gigabyte weights. Individual GGUF, LiteRT and Whisper files can then be imported explicitly.
models.folderScanAndroidOnly: Direct SAF folder scanning is currently available on Android.
models.noFiles: No supported model files were found in this folder.
models.importAvailable: is now available in the local model library.
models.artifactOnly: Companion or runtime artifact — not imported alone.
models.accessAllowed: Allowed. You can revoke this in Android settings.
models.accessOptional: Optional. Needed only to browse non-media files outside folders you select.
models.pickerSafer: Selected files and folders continue to use Android’s safer system picker. This permission is never requested automatically.
models.folderScanBody: Direct SAF folder scanning is currently available on Android.
models.accessExplanation: This optional Android permission can browse shared non-media files. Selected folders continue to use the safer system picker.
models.noSupportedFiles: No supported model files were found in this folder.
storage.notGranted: Not granted — individual folder selection still works
storage.managePermission: Manage Android all files access permission
storage.explanation: This optional Android permission lets Jarvis scan model files in shared folders. You can keep it disabled and select individual folders through Android’s folder picker instead. Jarvis will re-check the permission when you return.
models.notStandalone: This artifact is not a standalone model. Its full pack and runtime compatibility must be validated first.
